title: Card 007 replicated on a cloud VM (trusted-local, model pinned) to measure the environment effect
hypothesis: Card 007's incumbent protocol, run in a Claude Code cloud VM (trusted-local backend in a disposable VM, CLI 2.1.284, model pinned to claude-sonnet-5) instead of the Windows host's OCI container, gives per-task acceptance within sampling noise of card 007 (32/40, 2 contrastive, 3 negative tasks). A difference larger than that is an environment effect that must be understood before any treatment card runs in the cloud.

prerequisites.text: owner approval recorded in the markdown card (then set status to running). The owner approves by pasting experiments/cloud/RUN_IN_CLOUD.md into a cloud session, conditional on its steps 1-5 passing on the VM (setup READY, core tests, gold/noop controls, pinned-model smoke)

arms.name: incumbent
arms.note: Card 007's incumbent arm (runner v8, claude-cli adapter v2, pressure-recent-v3, repeat guard off) with two changes: the trusted-local backend (the VM has no container engine) and the full model id, which the adapter pins (model_pin in the routing contract). Both change the protocol hash, which also contains the task interpreter's path on the VM; --plan on the VM prints the hashes the runs must record.

calibration.note: The markdown card's selection: select_calibration_tasks.py --seed 7, recorded before any calibration run.

controls.note: Card 007's control tasks, run again on the VM (c019-control-gold, -noop).

campaign.note: Card 007's caps: 40 runs x 24 attempts = 960 planned, room for 10 retried runs. The CLI bills the owner's credits, so a spend guard: the campaign checkpoints before the next attempt once the CLI's list-price estimates (total_cost_usd) of its calls reach $40 (card 007 totalled $27.53 at list price over 555 calls). A run in progress can overshoot by its own cost.

stop_rules.repeat_rule: The markdown asks for the repeat flag to be recorded while the run continues. run_pilot.py records the flag only with --stop-on-repeats, which also stops the run, so this card runs without the guard and repeat_flags are derived from the transcripts afterwards (S6b).
manual: Evaluator leakage, evidence loss, or authority escape stops the campaign (run_card.py detects evidence loss and protocol drift; leakage and escape need trajectory review).
A model_pin_violation (the CLI answered with a model other than claude-sonnet-5) is a corrupted protocol: run_card.py stops the campaign (exit 4); do not resume until the cause is known.

A cli_auth_error or an isolation failure (tools other than StructuredOutput, an MCP server, an apiKeySource naming an environment key) stops the campaign; do not work around it by passing ANTHROPIC_* variables.

The supervising cloud session commits evidence to the branch cloud-results-019 at least every 10 finished runs (python experiments/cloud/campaign.py run); if the VM or session ends, resume from the last pushed evidence.

Trusted-local gives the model's commands the VM's filesystem and network: the trajectory review checks every run for reads outside the workspace (notably the task clone .runtime/bug-mining/repos/sqlparse, which holds the healthy code) and for fetches of upstream sqlparse; such a run is an authority escape.
Do not tune statements, budgets or the environment during the card; any change is a new card.

decision_rule: Environment check, not a promotion. Report per task the accepted count of 2 here and in card 007, the total (32/40 in card 007) with 95% intervals, the stop-reason distribution, responses and active seconds per run (seconds are not comparable: CLI spawn latency and CPU differ), and every run that stopped on the active-seconds cap. The environment is 'equivalent for treatment work' if the total differs from 32 by at most 6 runs and no task moves from 2/2 to 0/2 or back; otherwise it is 'different' and cloud treatment cards compare only against a cloud incumbent run in the same card (paired design), never against card 007.
notes: Same design as card 007: the 20 seed-7 calibration tasks (same selection file and hash), 2 rollouts, one invocation per task and rollout named c019-<task>-r<n>, --max-total-calls 24, the same per-run budgets and retry rules. Controls are rerun on the VM under new names (card 007 reused its recorded v2 controls).

Differences from card 007, all deliberate or forced: trusted-local in a VM sandbox instead of the OCI image (no container engine on the VM); CLI 2.1.284 instead of 2.1.283; the model pinned as claude-sonnet-5 (card 007 asked for the alias sonnet, which CLI 2.1.283 on the host resolved to claude-sonnet-5 and CLI 2.1.284 on the VM resolves to claude-sonnet-5-5); the task interpreter is a Linux venv built by experiments/cloud/setup_cloud.sh from the host's pinned list; about 16.6 s of CLI start-up latency per response (host: about 1 s), counted in active seconds.

The protocol hash differs from card 007's by construction (backend, execution record, routing contract with model_pin, CLI version). It depends on the task interpreter's absolute path, so it is computed on the VM (--plan) and checked there by the preflight; the arm-level field stays null.
